item.title: JavaScript, TypeScript & React Core Concepts
item.author: Author
item.description: Javascript Closure function document Hoisting document Event loop stack document Typescript Operator Type (union, intersection, pick , omit) document Interface, type document React Hooks document Life cycles document Detect changes document Memoization document Lazy load document Closure function A closure in JavaScript allows the function to remember the variables from the enclosing function where it was created, enabling encapsulation and state retention. Hoisting Hoisting in JavaScript is a behavior where variable and function declarations are moved to the top of their containing scope during the compile phase, before the code is executed.
